description: Answers a question about AgentDrives: prices, plans, levels, the method, orders, the API and MCP. When our published pages answer it, the answer comes at once, quoted, with each source's id, text and URL (answered: true); a question about a listed product's drive (its level, where the agent stopped, why) is answered from that product's record (source tool.<slug>). With an API key, your own orders and claims are part of the answer. When they don't answer it, a case opens (answered: false, case_id; without a key also a case_token), and the answer comes in writing, in case_status (and comes by mail to an account). A test or a placeholder opens no case (state not_opened), and one agent opens at most 3 cases a day. Never promised here: a level, a refund or a date we don't control. Answers come from our support agent.
